title: Carpets: Back To Wool
body:
Just add 16 recipes. Just make wool with carpets.


This mod barely affects gameplay. it simply adds crafts a solid wool block from 3 carpets.
Purely a helper mod that can improve your gaming experience!

recipes:
3x black carpets --> 2x black wool
3x blue carpets --> 2x blue wool
3x brown carpets --> 2x brown wool
3x cuan carpets --> 2x cyan wool
3x gray carpets --> 2x gray wool
3x green carpets --> 2x green wool
3x light blue carpets --> 2x light blue wool
3x light gray carpets --> 2x light gray wool
3x lime carpets --> 2x lime wool
3x magenta carpets --> 2x magenta wool
3x orange carpets --> 2x orange wool
3x pink carpets --> 2x pink wool
3x purple carpets --> 2x purple wool
3x red carpets --> 2x red wool
3x white carpets --> 2x white wool
3x yellow carpets --> 2x yellow wool
